design: One new physical from-home policy + online grasp-WM prefix per scene/color. Save the actual handoff decision and actuator state. All placement variants consume the same handoff RGB and start state; rotate first uninterrupted branch, then restore (contact cache unavailable). Train: student proposes, RGB expert labels every valid decision, mixed behavior replaces targets outside the 50 mm radius plus 5 mm slack inset, or inconsistent/no target. Execute uncorrected student and a balanced red / near-edge / over-edge / center calibration probe too. Retrain only placement LoRA using original examples and new matched swap pairs. Fit a separate action-conditioned terminal outcome model from real simulated placement outcomes (final can XY, color, strictness and last-2s clearance), never expert agreement as outcome. Dev: compare previous, DAgger, DAgger + model reranking candidate goals, simple visual correction rule, always expert. All share the original grasp stack; no RL, test access or real hardware.
